## Placeholder
`Placeholder` is hidden until `show`: add `rp-placeholder-show`, or let shared.js show it for a table with `data-rp-empty-for="tableId"` (no rows after a search or a filter).
```html
<div class="rp-placeholder" data-rp-empty-for="usersTable">
  <span class="rp-icon rp-icon-size-80 rp-icon-not-found"></span>
  <div class="rp-placeholder-content"><span class="rp-placeholder-title">No users found</span><span>Try another name or email, or clear the filters</span></div>
  <button type="button" class="rp-default-button rp-default-button-size-small" data-rp-clear-filters="usersTable">Clear filters</button>
</div>
```
Copy: what is empty + how to fix it. A first-use empty state and a no-results state never share a message. Error state: "Unable to load data" + what to do + a retry action.

## Loader, skeleton
```html
<span class="rp-loader" role="status" aria-label="Loading"></span>
<span class="rp-skeleton" style="width: 60%"></span>
```

## Progress bar
```html
<div class="rp-progress-bar">
  <div class="rp-progress-bar-label"><span>Service</span><span>91.2%</span></div>
  <div class="rp-progress-bar-track" role="progressbar" aria-label="Service" aria-valuenow="91.2" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100"><div class="rp-progress-bar-value" style="width: 91.2%"></div></div>
</div>
```

## Rules
- No state switchers: states appear through a real interaction (a search with no results, a short loader after a click).
